title: Starbucks Plans 'Fast Pass' to Automate Drive-Thru Orders Using Mobile App
summary:
CEO Brian Niccol said the company is developing a system that identifies participating customers' vehicles to speed up checkout and order confirmation at its drive-thrus. The proposed "fast pass" workflow would use the Starbucks mobile app to recognize a car upon arrival and display the customer's frequent orders for a barista to confirm, allowing the transaction to be paid before the vehicle reaches the window.

The technology is part of a broader push into AI that includes tools to improve order entry accuracy for baristas and personalized digital menus. Niccol, who previously led marketing and innovation at Taco Bell, stated the chain is in the early stages of development and plans to test the features, including those for the 2027 fiscal year, before scaling them across the company.

selectedTweets.text:
STARBUCKS $SBUX IS PREPARING TO TEST AI IN ITS DRIVE-THRUS

The AI would run in the background to help baristas enter orders faster and more accurately, CEO Brian Niccol said on Thursday's earnings call, per Bloomberg.

Starbucks is also exploring technology that recognizes participating customers when they arrive, then shows them personalized menus and makes paying easier.

"We're early in this work and we'll test, learn and scale what works."

selectedTweets.bestBit: The app recognizes your car…the barista confirms and its paid
selectedTweets.text:
Starbucks CEO Brian Niccol says a use case of AI will be to create "fast pass" at the drive-thru. The app recognizes your car…the barista confirms and its paid:

“One of the things that's pretty unique about our drive-thru experience is a lot of our baristas and customers know each other through the order board. I want that connection and that human-to-human experience to get even stronger.

So what we're going to do with the AI tools is really going to be behind the scenes to help with order accuracy and inputting your order quicker.

The other thing that I think is really exciting is we're going to have almost like the ability to have like a fast pass for the drive-thru. When you pull up to the drive-thru, if you're in our app, it will recognize you.

It'll show the order that you placed historically, so it's already right up there. The barista will be like, 'Brian, is it the usual?' You'll be like, 'Yes.' Great. It's paid. Now you're off to the window to pick up your drink and out you go.

It'll be the fastest drive-thru experience you can have. We haven't named it yet, but I feel like this is going to be a fast pass.”
